title: Annotatio III §.X (4) cont.: No such sneer in Trypho/Celsus/Julian/Porphyry — nor in Justin, Tertullian, Origen, Arnobius, Minucius
pass_a_gloss: Yet that this was done even once, or by any of the most hostile enemies of the Christian sect, we read nowhere exposed — neither in their writings (say of Trypho, Celsus, Julian, Porphyry, who as studiously as possible seized every handle for most calumniously traducing Christian Dogmas) nor in the Apologetic writings of any of the most diligent Assertors of Christian truths (such as Justin Martyr, Tertullian, Origen, Arnobius and Minucius Felix are remembered).
pass_b_english: Yet we nowhere read that even once from the fiercest enemies — Trypho, Celsus, Julian, Porphyry — who hunted every handle to calumniate Christian dogmas.
Nor from the careful apologists Justin, Tertullian, Origen, Arnobius, Minucius Felix.
source_text: Id quod tamen, vel semel, vel ab ullo hostium Christianæ sectæ infestissimorum, factitatum esse, nullibi, nec in ipsorum (Tryphonis puta, Celsi, Juliani, Porphyrii, omnem profectò ansam Dogmata Christiana calumniosissimè traducendi, quàm studiosè captantium) nec in cujuspiam ex diligentissimis Christianarum veritatum Assertoribus (quales Justinus Martyr, Tertullianus, Origenes, Arnobius & Minutius Felix memorantur) Scriptis Apologeticis expositum legimus.
